how_captured: The EGamersWorld match list and event pages block datacentre requests (HTTP 403 from the CI runner, and Cloudflare's block page even through public reader proxies), so the pages were read with the session's own browser-style fetcher and the exact bytes were inspected before any number was written here. Each row below was typed from the served markup of the linked match page; the event page that lists every row of the capture is recorded as capture_url.

time_conversion.displayed: EGamersWorld clocks are not stable between reads: the same fixture (ENCE vs BOJONG, fixture 1080280) renders as 10:00 in the page title, 12:00 in the match header of the same page and 11:00 in an earlier event-list read, while the lobby API reports 10:00Z.
time_conversion.rule: No UTC value is derived from an EGamersWorld clock. A row joins only on its fixture_id hint plus both team names.
time_conversion.verification: The page-title clock matched the lobby API exactly on 1080280 ('ENCE VS BOJONG: 15.10.2026 at 10:00' vs lobby 10:00Z) and the on-page countdown (1d 12h 12m, read 2026-10-13T21:48Z) lands on the same instant; the other two clocks on that page (11:00, 12:00) do not. Because the rendering differs per element, the displayed time is kept verbatim for review and never converted.
time_conversion.status: irregularity published for review; this capture publishes no UTC time of its own

rejected_from_capture.detail: The CCT Europe 2026 Series #11 schedule block showed exactly 1.80 / 1.80 for four different matches (Gothic vs Lavked, ex-RUSTEC vs mellren, G2 Ares vs The Last Resort, FORZE Reload vs an unnamed opponent). A repeated identical pair is a placeholder, not a market price, so none of those values is published.
